MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Lesley Gore feels like a natural next choice after AM Gold: The Mid-'60s because I am interested in familiar songs from that era.",
    "The Creedence Clearwater Revival, Eagles and Stevie Nicks collections fit my interest in classic rock and recognizable songs, reflected in The Cars and my rock hits compilations."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Adele interests me as a vocal pop artist, but that connection is less compelling today than familiar oldies and classic rock collections.",
    "I cannot judge Greatest Hits without knowing the artist; the compilation title alone does not tell me whether I would enjoy the songs.",
    "That's Christmas To Me connects with my latest listening, but one Christmas album does not mean I am ready to choose another without hearing it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in some pop albums seems to have been stretched into more enthusiasm for Adele than I currently feel.",
    "A greatest-hits title seems to count too much on its own, when the artist and songs are what make a collection appealing to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated choices of oldies and classic rock compilations matter more to this visit than my occasional interest in contemporary pop.",
    "Being open to an album is different from wanting to choose it now; I prioritize recognizable artists and familiar songs, and want a sample when I am less certain."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in classic hits, but sometimes treated a broad connection to pop, compilations or Christmas music as enough to make me choose an album now."
}
